text: Objectives This program focuses on comparison on language as well as cultural aspects between Chinese and English including etiquettes, legal systems, ethics, and academic writing skills. The program is designed for professionals who wish to work and succeed in various government agencies, educational institutions, and businesses. Candidates will develop high levels of language proficiency and keen intercultural sensitivity. Duration Duration of the program is 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Cross-cultural Studies 2. English Language Teaching Methodology 3. Sino-western Cross-cultural Communication and Integration 4. Academic Writing Skills and Academic Ethics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete 38 credits including 20 for required courses, 12 for elective courses, and 3 credits for seminars, reports and interim assessment. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
